---
title: "What happens when the boom has to hold its own weight?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
# The same wing study, once with the boom free to be any length and once with its
# tip deflection capped. Each answer is re-flown through the marched model.
free = wing_study()
stiff = wing_study(sag_limit=SAG_LIMIT)

def marched(r):
    airplane, layout = glider(aspect_ratio=r["aspect_ratio"], taper=r["taper"],
                              nose_chords=r["station"], **FIXED_TAIL)
    return simulate(airplane, layout, ballast=r["ballast"],
                    launch_angle=r["launch_angle"], v_launch=r["speed"])

m_free, m_stiff = marched(free), marched(stiff)

# The baseline these plans started from, as a check on the sag model itself.
base_layout = glider(**FIXED_TAIL)[1]
base_sag = boom_sag(base_layout, structural_mass(base_layout)["total"].mass + 3e-3)

assert free["sag"] > free["chord"]            # the free boom sags past its chord
assert base_sag / base_layout["c_root"] < 0.03   # a real aeroplane passes
assert stiff["aspect_ratio"] > 4 * free["aspect_ratio"]   # the shape inverts
assert m_stiff["duration"] < m_free["duration"]           # and it costs
```

::: {.hero-pair}
::: {.hero-ref}
[`{python} f"{free['sag'] * 1e3:.0f}"` mm]{.hero-value}
[the free boom's droop, unloaded on the bench]{.hero-label}
:::
::: {}
[`{python} f"{m_stiff['duration']:.2f}"` s]{.hero-value}
[once it has to hold its shape]{.hero-label}
:::
:::

**Answer.** It was buying time with a boom that cannot exist — free, the tip
deflects `{python} f"{free['sag'] / free['chord']:.0%}"` of its own chord and
folds on the bench. Capped, aspect ratio leaves the floor it sat on all chapter,
`{python} f"{free['aspect_ratio']:.2f}"` to
[`{python} f"{stiff['aspect_ratio']:.2f}"`]{.key}, the boom shortens to
`{python} f"{stiff['boom'] * 1e3:.0f}"` mm, and the flight costs
`{python} f"{m_free['duration'] - m_stiff['duration']:.2f}"` s (@tbl-sag).
Deflection scales as length⁴.

::: {.callout-warning}
## The answer now rests on a stiffness I guessed
EPS is quoted 5–15 MPa. A clamped strip and a coin would settle it.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. **Foam modulus `{python} f"{FOAM_E / 1e6:.0f}"` MPa**, mid-range and unmeasured.
2. **Tail carries 15%** of weight in trim.
3. **Cantilever, rigid root**; no taper in the boom.
4. **Cap `{python} f"{SAG_LIMIT:.0%}"` of chord**, the usual rule of thumb.
:::
